第一卷 第5章 年少骄狂欺我老朽（第1页）
“就是这破院子，昨天那百岁老东西就住这。”
“啧啧，真是晦气，咱们青玄宗什么时候收过这种半截入土的货色？”
三道年轻傲慢的声音，在院门口响起。
为首少年青衣束发，面容倨傲，正是昨日被苏玄尘逼退的外门执事弟子——赵山。
他身后跟着两名跟班弟子，皆是炼气二层修为，平日里依附赵山，在外门横行惯了。
三人一大早特意绕路过来，就是为了寻苏玄尘的麻烦。
赵山昨日当众被一个百岁老者逼退，颜面尽失。
一夜过去，心中怨气丝毫未消，反倒愈发恼怒。
院门被直接推开，三道身影大步踏入院中。
赵山目光扫过院中站立的苏玄尘，满脸戏谑轻蔑。
“老东西，命倒是挺硬，居然还没死。”
历经百年风霜，他早已不会被几句恶语激怒。
“同门修行，当守宗门礼法。诸位无故闯我居所，出言辱我，不合规矩。”
赵山像是听到了天大的笑话，嗤笑出声。
“规矩是给天才、给同门修士定的。”
“你一个百岁老朽，勉强混进宗门，也配跟我讲规矩？”
“赵师兄说得没错！宗门收少年英才，你一把年纪占着外门居所、耗着宗门灵气，本身就是坏了规矩！”
“依我看，你还是自己识趣点，主动滚出青玄宗，免得天天惹人笑话！”
三人你一言我一语，句句刻薄，字字嘲讽。
在他们眼中，苏玄尘的存在，本身就是一个笑话。
修仙一道，讲究少年筑基，气血鼎盛，大道可期。
百岁之人，寿元枯竭，肉身朽坏，道心早该枯死。
苏玄尘微微垂眸，声音平淡却带着几分凛然：
“宗门执事亲自破例收我，长老未曾逐我，你们区区外门弟子，无权驱我。”
他最不爽的，就是这老者一副云淡风轻、不卑不亢的模样。
明明是最底层的累赘，偏偏气度沉稳，丝毫不见怯懦。
赵山向前踏出一步，炼气四层的灵力悄然涌动。
淡淡的灵力威压，朝着苏玄尘压迫而去。
“我今日便告诉你，在外门这一亩三分地，我的道理，就是规矩！”
“我给你最后一次机会，自己收拾东西滚，还是要我动手赶你滚？”
灵力威压如山，狠狠碾压向苍老身躯。
两名跟班弟子抱臂冷笑，静静等着看老者跪地服软、狼狈退让。
在他们看来，炼气四层压制炼气一层，根本就是碾压。
可下一秒，他们脸上的笑容，骤然僵住。
威压笼罩之下，苏玄尘身形笔直伫立院中。
那双浑浊褪去、深邃沉静的眼眸，平静望着骄狂少年。
赵山瞳孔微微收缩，心底莫名一震。

Volume 1 Chapter 5 The young and arrogant bully me (Page 1)
"It's this shabby courtyard. The hundred-year-old guy lived here yesterday."
"Tsk, tsk, that's really unlucky. When did our Qingxuan Sect ever collect such half-buried goods?"
Three young and arrogant voices sounded at the entrance of the courtyard.
The leading young man in green clothes with his hair tied up and an arrogant face is none other than Zhao Shan, the outer deacon disciple who was forced to retreat by Su Xuanchen yesterday.
Behind him were two disciples, both of whom were at the second level of Qi Refining. They usually relied on Zhao Shan and were used to running rampant in the outer sect.
The three of them took a special detour early in the morning just to look for trouble in Su Xuanchen.
Zhao Shan was forced to retreat by a hundred-year-old man in front of everyone yesterday, and his face was completely lost.
As the night passed, the resentment in my heart did not disappear at all, but instead became more and more angry.
The courtyard door was pushed open directly, and three figures strode into the courtyard.
Zhao Shan glanced at Su Xuanchen standing in the courtyard, his face full of teasing contempt.
"Old guy, your life is pretty good, you're not dead yet."
After a hundred years of hard work, he is no longer irritated by a few bad words.
"Fellow practitioners should abide by the sect's etiquette. You broke into my residence for no reason and insulted me. It is against the rules."
Zhao Shan laughed out loud as if he had heard a big joke.
"The rules are for geniuses and fellow monks."
"You are a hundred-year-old old man who barely managed to get into the sect. Do you deserve to tell me the rules?"
"Senior Brother Zhao is right! The sect accepts young talents. If you occupy the outer sect's residence and consume the sect's spiritual energy at your age, you are breaking the rules!"
"In my opinion, you'd better be wiser and get out of Qingxuan Sect, so as not to make people laugh every day!"
The three of them said something mean and sarcastic to each other.
In their eyes, Su Xuanchen's existence itself was a joke.
When cultivating immortality, it is important to build a foundation with young people, so that the Qi and blood are at their peak, and the great path can be expected.
A hundred-year-old person's lifespan is exhausted, his body is decayed, and his Taoist mind should have withered long ago.
Su Xuanchen lowered his eyes slightly and said in a calm but awe-inspiring voice:
"The deacon of the sect personally made an exception to accept me. The elders have never expelled me. You, the mere outside disciples, have no right to expel me."
What displeased him the most was that the old man looked calm and neither humble nor arrogant.
He is obviously a burden at the bottom, but he has a calm demeanor and shows no signs of cowardice.
Zhao Shan took a step forward, and the spiritual power of the fourth level of Qi Refining quietly surged.
A faint spiritual pressure pressed towards Su Xuanchen.
"I will tell you today that in this three-acre area in the outer gate, my principles are the rules!"
"Should I give you one last chance to pack your things and get out, or do you want me to drive you out?"
The spiritual power was as powerful as a mountain, crushing the old body hard.
The two disciples crossed their arms and sneered, waiting quietly to see the old man kneeling in submission and giving in in embarrassment.
In their opinion, the fourth level of Qi refining suppresses the first level of Qi refining, which is simply crushing.
But the next second, the smiles on their faces suddenly froze.
Under the pressure, Su Xuanchen stood upright in the courtyard.
Those deep and calm eyes, with their turbidity gone, looked at the arrogant young man calmly.
Zhao Shan's pupils shrank slightly, and his heart was inexplicably shocked.
